verdicts.notes: The 844x390 part (no dispatch) is today's layout kept by decision 226 (a): accepted; the caption still names the phase and the live event there. No decision record mentions browser zoom or reflow, so the 400% / 320 px part (WCAG 1.4.10 AA) stands at S2/P2. Origin inherited (0a19964, 1613575). Remedy feasible; the phone cases of decisions 223-226 and 232 must hold.

verdicts.method: reproduced: own phone.js/phone2.js, visitor phone page 390x844 (density 3, touch), elementFromPoint hit map per px, CDP touch drags, touchscreen.tap; code reading
verdicts.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-repro-ux-maps/phone.json, phone2.json, phone-rail-tap-marker.jpg. Middle line (y 832): markers 64.2% (20 of 25), rail 35.8%. Drag 60 px right from the rail (x 51.5): 09:30 to 07:52 (follows the finger). The same drag from a marker (x 121.5) or 60 px left from another (x 233.5): clock unchanged, nothing selected. Tap on the marker: 08:25, e:decision selected, dossier open. Code: style.css:344, 379-382, 794; app.js:7529-7531.
verdicts.notes: Decision 167 covers the markers' target size only. Origin inherited (0a19964; step 6 Part B's phone timeline).

corrected.observed: Markers take 64.2% of the rail's middle line (the area: 65.8%) and 4.5% 4 px above its foot (the area: 9.4%). But a real touch drag from (121.5, 840), where elementFromPoint returns the rail, did not scrub either (run twice). So 'the rail's bottom 4 px' is no reliable escape under a marker, which makes the defect slightly worse than stated.

verdicts.method: code reading at HEAD + own read-backs (desk.json 1600x900 Study/Watch/Clean by real clicks; phone.json Menu, Layers and sources sheet by real taps)
verdicts.evidence: style.css:584 (<1080 px), 624 (<=430 px), 415/422 (Watch, Clean); shell.html:206 (the only .legend); tools/visual/phone-measure.js:85-87 (no key in FEAT). docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-repro-ux-maps/desk.json: Study legend at [1489,753,93,42]; Watch and Clean legend none, no Key button. phone.json: legend none; the Menu's 12 buttons have no key; Layers explains only the grades and dashed routes; the sources sheet has no hit for status, echelon, XXX, glyph or viewshed.
verdicts.notes: Scope: Watch and Clean hide the key by their stated purpose; from there the key is two presses away (1, then Key, closed by default under decision 49). The real gap is below 1080 px wide or <=430 px tall, where no presentation offers it. STAGE3_SPEC.md:694-695 is a record, not a decision. S2 kept: the integrity marks are largely unexplained on phones. Origin inherited.

verdicts.method: own desk.js read-backs, the paper map entered by real clicks at 1600x900 and 1280x720 plus Landscape with counters at the Overview 1280x720; capture; code reading; 1024 from the area's raw JSON (inspected, not re-run)
verdicts.evidence: docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-repro-ux-maps/desk.json and paper-entered-1600x900.jpg, paper-entered-1280x720.jpg: 36 items (counters 14, event 1, plateau 1, overlay 7, objective 1 on), all 12 places dropped at both sizes and at the Overview with counters; no village, stream or hill name visible. docs/audit-post8-evidence/visual-maps/d1024/paper-entered.json: 12 dropped. Code: app.js:5163 (places pri 8/8.5), 5157 (overlay labels pri 6), 5259-5264 (a place needs its marker point and a hugging slot free), 5267-5270 (on the paper map other labels may roam to far rings with leaders), 5298 (leaders reserve no space); thresholds.js:22 (paper-north-up 20, paper-laptop 21).
verdicts.notes: The cause is more specific than 'priority': counters and labels take each place's own slot first, while a place may never move away from its marker. Both remedies are feasible; re-baselining needs the owner's word. Origin inherited (2D, 2E), not checked on an archive build. 1024 not re-run by me.
